kaikki_vikisozluk.e: سَأَفَ • (saʔafa) I (non-past يَسْأَفُ (yasʔafu), verbal noun سَأْف (saʔf))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See سَعَف (saʕaf, “palm branches having leaves”), as سَأَف (saʔaf) is glossed the opposite, “palm branches stripped of leaves”.
g: to be rent, to be pared, to be chapped, to be affected by fissures, to have fibres or rind or keratin divided

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: (obsolete)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See سَعَف (saʕaf, “palm branches having leaves”), as سَأَف (saʔaf) is glossed the opposite, “palm branches stripped of leaves”.
g: bristles, hair at the end of the tail of a wolf
